image_description: A night-time urban street scene featuring a traffic light pole in the foreground. The pole supports two signal units: an upper circular red light and a lower pedestrian crossing signal displaying a green 'walking person' icon. In the background, there is a building facade with illuminated windows and signage that appears to read 'SNRIS' or similar, along with a 'NO PARKING ANY TIME' sign attached to the pole.
